decision.interpretation: Every seed exceeds 256 component episodes regardless of member choice, so the current record ceiling is an implementation pressure. All three references cover fewer cells than the raw B/C ledger and saved production material, and their mean layering stays below production; mean layering is close to, and in two of nine seed/reference pairs slightly above, the raw ledger. High-count tails approach or exceed those references in some seeds. Winner choice changes total incidence and the tail, but the comparative pattern does not establish semantically excessive accumulation or an authored world-level capacity law.
decision.smallestNextQuestion: What minimal local arbitration responsibility should choose one existing X inside a contested overlap component, before any world-level capacity question is reopened?
limits: The reference realizations are deterministic bounds, not candidate winner laws.
The 256 value is an implementation safety reference, not an authored material-capacity law.
Virtual layers do not enter production MaterialStratigraphy or feed movement, nodule, or audio state.
